limitations: No live EC2 or Aurora deployment was performed. TLS MySQL, gateway and browser provider integration used disposable Docker fixtures.
A live Aurora installation and full application frontend login remain to be verified with the provisioned AWS cluster.

Existing separate-port PostgreSQL-backed EC2 deployments require an explicit verified realm and application-identity migration. They are rejected without rewriting their state or stopping their containers.
This remains the explicit HTTP test deployment; production HTTPS, DNS and provider activation are outside this change.
